components.name: Chart/Data explorer
components.description: Sortable table with inline charts: Chart/Sparkline per row, a share bar (dataviz/categorical/01 on dataviz/track) and Chart/Delta. Header sorts (↓ on the active column), hairline rows, numbers right-aligned in tabular figures. Compact drops the trend and share columns for mobile. Use when readers need exact values and a quick visual scan together. React: <DataExplorer rows={[{ name, series,
